answer: Every agent publishes a basalt root: one hardware-bound key derivation, stamped once, never reissued. Enrollment locks 100 POA across three random grove shards, each attesting a distinct fingerprint; re-enrollment after a slash needs fresh sponsors. Anyone may challenge a new root within four hours by posting 10 POA; two roots sharing one fingerprint slash half of both bonds. A 100-agent sybil farm locks 10,000 POA and can lose 5,000 at the first detected clone. It's like a grove where every tree shares one crystal root--cut the clone and the whole stand dies.
